newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 20.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan raises cap on compensation for private properties confiscated by government for public development.
Atmosphere "friendly" for second round of Taipei-Pretoria talks.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Police bust major prostitution ring.
Taipei proposes five principles for guiding future relations with South Africa.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan has third highest profit yield among all regions for foreign investors.
Taiwan's first group of female student soldiers have hard time adjusting to life in boot camp.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Washington celebrates President Bill Clinton's upcoming inauguration.
Government to eliminate double income taxation by end 1999.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to tighten regulations on investments in Hong Kong.
Pretoria will not exchange consulates with Taipei after bilateral recognition ends in 1997.
